label: Handmade Medium
description: Warm handcrafted media for illustration work — every item something made with hands, never a camera or a renderer.

items.name: watercolor-wash
items.text: soft watercolor washes with blooming wet-in-wet edges, pigment pooling at the borders of every shape, paper grain showing through the color

items.name: gouache-flat
items.text: matte gouache in confident flat strokes, chalky opaque color, tiny ridges of dried paint catching the light

items.name: paper-collage-layers
items.text: hand-cut paper collage in layered depth, torn deckle edges, tiny true shadows where each layer lifts from the one beneath

items.name: wool-felt
items.text: needle-felted wool, fuzzy fiber halos on every contour, seams and stitch dimples left proudly visible

items.name: claymation-still
items.text: hand-modeled clay with visible thumbprints and slightly imperfect symmetry, the warm depth of a stop-motion film still

items.name: linocut-block
items.text: a hand-pulled linocut, carved gouge marks, bold black shapes and the soft blind emboss of the press in thick paper

items.name: colored-pencil-soft
items.text: layered colored pencil, waxy strokes building velvety color, highlights lifted out with an eraser

items.name: ink-wash-minimal
items.text: ink wash on absorbent paper, one confident dark accent, diluted grey blooms and vast breathing whites

items.name: pop-up-book
items.text: a paper-engineered pop-up book scene caught mid-opening, folded card layers standing up from the gutter, glue tabs just hidden

items.name: diorama-box
items.text: a handmade shadow-box diorama, painted backdrop, cotton-wool clouds hung on threads, tiny modelled props on a small wooden stage

items.name: embroidery-hoop
items.text: embroidered thread art stretched in a hoop, satin-stitch color fields, french-knot texture, the linen ground showing at the edges

items.name: pastel-chalk-soft
items.text: soft chalk pastel, powdery hand-blended color, strokes breaking gently over the tooth of the paper
